Name: Cage Free Eggs
Author: cat9412
Description:
[size=3]This mod aims to add a Vegan option of getting eggs, and what other way than to make them crops! 

This mod [b]REQUIRES[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] ﻿to work, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ is needed to get late game eggs. Thank you for understanding :D!

I am by no means a Pixel artist, if these sprites look familiar there's a reason! (Credit to ConcernedApe for the sprites I borrowed and edited ^^')  If anyone wants to help redo with the sprite work of the mod I'd gladly love the help <3[/size]

[size=4][b][u][i]How IT Works:[/i][/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Buy Egg Plant, Large Egg Plant, and Duck Egg Plant seeds from Pierre[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]The plants are grown in time frames similar to getting the actual animals, and produce comes about as often[/size]
[/list][list=1]
[*][size=4]Egg Plant (and Brown Egg Plant)[/size][size=3] - 4 Days to mature, produces 2-3 eggs every 3 days (I didn't think anyone would want to harvest them EVERY. SINGLE. DAY. so I spaced it out. Also made this 2-3 eggs instead of 3 to account for the fact you don't have to feed or pet the plant. [/size][size=1]I mean yeah you gotta water em but not forever there's sprinklers don't hurt me[/size]
[*][size=4]Large Egg Plant[/size][size=3] - 10 Days to mature, produces 1-3 eggs every 3 days[/size]
[*][size=4]Duck Egg Plant - [/size][size=3]5 Days to mature, produces 1 egg every 2 days [/size][size=1](let me know if its too often and I can change it)[/size]
[*][size=4]Void Egg Plant - [/size][size=3]10 Days to mature, produces 2-3 eggs every 3 days[/size]
[*][size=4]Dino Egg Plant - [/size][size=3]12 Days to mature, produces 1 egg a week[/size]
[*][size=4][spoiler]Ostrich Plant - [/size][size=3]19 Days to mature, produces 1 egg a week[/size][size=4] [/spoiler][/size]
[*][size=4][spoiler][/size][size=4]Golden Egg Plant [/size]- 10 Days to mature, produces 2-3 eggs every 3 days [size=4][/spoiler][/size]

[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][list]
[*][b][size=4]All eggs that can't be bought from stores, also can't be bought with this mod.[/size][/b][size=3] This is where Producer Framework Mod comes in, When you receive one of these eggs, instead of putting them into an incubator to get the animal, put them into a Seed Maker to get the plant ^^[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]

Big THANK YOU!! to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]KAYA[/url] for making the Korean translation <3
[/size]

[size=3]Any suggestions are greatly appreciated <3 Have a wonderful day![/size]
